Blood Testament Chapter 3 Patch Notes
오전 3시 15분
\[Patch Introduction]
\[Highlights]
New Weapon: Lancaster
A four barreled, medium ammo pistol with a rotating firing pin which allows for a high fire rate. Favored by Hunters on safari as a self-defense weapon due to its superior reliability and stopping power. Opening the break-action will always eject all rounds.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
New Variant: Lancaster Cleaver
A variant of the Lancaster with an under-barrel blade, changing its melee attacks to be similar to a Heavy Knife in both swing pattern and damage.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
World
All Bileweaver Infested Compounds (new and Old) will have a chance to spawn in Chapter 3. There will be 5 compounds active per game.
Fair Play Follow Up
Players get a follow up notification when a player they reported was banned
Players get a Hunt Dollar refund when they get killed by a player who was banned
High ping queue (Temporary test in Europe for the duration of Chapter 3)
Players get matchmade into a separate queue if their ping is above a threshold. The goal is to reduce exposure to high-latency gameplay. Should they not be able to find a match, they rejoin the regular matchmaking queue.
\[Upcoming Updates]
New Community Event: “Reap the Harvest”
“Reap the Harvest” is a new Community Event that is planned to start later in Chapter 3. The Community Event will consist of 5 Stages, each offering a reward to the whole of the community. Players will progress the Community Event by earning Community Event Points which is done by completing objectives in matches.
Community Event Stage Rewards
Stage 1: 5K Hunt Dollars & 1K Event Points
Stage 2: Lancaster (New Weapon)
Stage 3: 10K Hunt Dollars & 2.5K Event Points
Stage 4: Lancaster Cleaver (New Weapon)
Stage 5: Random Legendary Skin

First review ever but out of tough love.
I have played this game pretty close on release and absolutely love the gunplay, world, maps and more.
But my god have they ruined it for me with 1 thing. Self revive.
Solo players went from tactical and careful to aggressive and fool prove with this change.
I'll put a personal example below for anyone interested.
But anyway. Crytek stop buffing solo players and keep the game brutal and nerve wracking as it was intended.
Example on why self revive should disappear:
In a duo match I was banishing a boss with roughly around 3-4 teams/solo's, surrounding the compound.
Things slowly started to get heated but me and my teammate were able to kill a few enemies that started to get in. To our surprise we killed the first wave of players and quickly tried to initiate the enemies on the outer walls of the building before they got in.
However, one corpse that lay in the building got up and shot us in the back. Pretty hard to notice if your in mid-combat.
There is no way to know after you kill a player if its solo or not. And if you don't have traps on hand, he can just get up anytime he wants.
Sorry but this is just stupid. Why would anyone in any shooter want to focus on a corpse while there are enemies at your doorstep. You die you loose. If your in a team, your teammate needs to go through a lot of trouble for a revive. Even with necromancy your teammate looses health and sight, it also takes forever and he can easily be spotted while doing so. That is way more reasonable than ''Press Self Revive'' button.
Thank you for listening to my TED talk.
